crossRefs.note: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t…

parallels.note: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

translations.web: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
translations.bsb: So the disciples left and went into the city, where they found everything as Jesus had described. And they prepared the Passover.
translations.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
translations.asv: And the disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
